base_swing.swing_high: middle HIGH strictly greater than adjacent H1 HIGHs; known at close of right adjacent H1 candle
base_swing.swing_low: middle LOW strictly less than adjacent H1 LOWs; known at close of right adjacent H1 candle

directional_context.long: most recent H1 FVG before disturbance is bullish and a confirmed ITH target exists above the H1 close
directional_context.short: most recent H1 FVG before disturbance is bearish and a confirmed ITL target exists below the H1 close
directional_context.target_selector: nearest already-confirmed ITH above price for long; nearest already-confirmed ITL below price for short

disturbance.cycle_deadline: 120 complete H1 candles after disturbance knowledge time
disturbance.long: first bearish H1 FVG after the aligned bullish H1 FVG while the frozen ITH target remains unreached
disturbance.short: first bullish H1 FVG after the aligned bearish H1 FVG while the frozen ITL target remains unreached

entry_stop_target.long_entry: first complete M1 ASK open at or after trigger knowledge time, plus adverse entry slippage
entry_stop_target.short_entry: first complete M1 BID open at or after trigger knowledge time, minus adverse entry slippage

h1_fvg.bearish: for H1 candles C1,C2,C3, C1.low > C3.high; known at C3 close
h1_fvg.bullish: for H1 candles C1,C2,C3, C1.high < C3.low; known at C3 close

ith_itl.ith: an H1 swing high strictly above the immediately preceding and immediately following H1 swing highs; known only when following swing high is itself confirmed
ith_itl.itl: an H1 swing low strictly below the immediately preceding and immediately following H1 swing lows; known only when following swing low is itself confirmed

m15_pivots.swing_high: middle HIGH strictly greater than adjacent M15 HIGHs; known at close of right adjacent M15 candle
m15_pivots.swing_low: middle LOW strictly less than adjacent M15 LOWs; known at close of right adjacent M15 candle

shrinking_retracement_pattern.long_depths: D1=H1-L1, D2=H2-L2, D3=H3-L3; require D3 < D2 < D1 and all > 0
shrinking_retracement_pattern.long_progress: H2.price > H1.price and H3.price > H2.price and L2.price > L1.price and L3.price > L2.price
shrinking_retracement_pattern.long_sequence: H1,L1,H2,L2,H3,L3 alternating confirmed M15 pivots after disturbance
shrinking_retracement_pattern.short_depths: D1=H1-L1, D2=H2-L2, D3=H3-L3; require D3 < D2 < D1 and all > 0
shrinking_retracement_pattern.short_progress: L2.price < L1.price and L3.price < L2.price and H2.price < H1.price and H3.price < H2.price
shrinking_retracement_pattern.short_sequence: L1,H1,L2,H2,L3,H3 alternating confirmed M15 pivots after disturbance

trigger.long: first complete M15 candle after L3 is known whose close is strictly above H3.price
trigger.short: first complete M15 candle after H3 is known whose close is strictly below L3.price

research_question: Does a causal HTF target plus aligned H1 FVG momentum, followed by an opposing H1 FVG disturbance and three shrinking M15 retracements, identify a profitable symmetric continuation edge on the OANDA NAS100_USD CFD proxy?

source_backed_semantics.cycle: A disturbance can lead to consolidation/retracement and then expansion toward the still-valid target.
source_backed_semantics.ltf_context: Best lower-timeframe entries occur when the higher timeframe is ready to expand.
source_backed_semantics.market_structure: Use a higher-timeframe directional objective before looking for a lower-timeframe entry.
source_backed_semantics.momentum: FVGs are signs of momentum; opposing same-timeframe or one-timeframe-lower FVGs are disturbances.
source_backed_semantics.order_flow: Recent FVG/order-flow legs refine where continuation may resume and where price should not retrace.
source_backed_semantics.target: ITH/ITL are liquidity magnets; the closest target becomes more compelling as price approaches.
source_backed_semantics.timing: Shrinking retracements at consolidation extremes indicate momentum building toward expansion.
